title: Coherent objects: finite images and filtered approximation
statement: Let $\mathcal E$ be a coherent Grothendieck topos in the universe convention of [def-weil-size-convention], with coherent objects and coherence of a topos defined in [def-trf-coherent-topos]. Finite coproducts and finite limits of coherent objects are coherent. The image of any morphism $A\to B$ between coherent objects is coherent, where image means the least subobject of $B$ through which the morphism factors. Every object $G$ of $\mathcal E$ is a small filtered colimit of coherent objects: there are a small nonempty category $I$ in which every finite diagram admits a cocone, a functor $i\mapsto C_i$ with coherent values, and a colimit isomorphism $\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}C_i\simeq G$. No claim is made that arbitrary subobjects of coherent objects are coherent.

source.place: Section 8.1, printed pp. 17–18, coherent-object finite-presentation calculus and filtered coherent approximation; image closure is also used explicitly in the last paragraph of the proof of Lemma 8.3.3, printed p. 19. This node isolates the general coherent-topos input; no SGA source is used.
